role: Separately authored review and controls within the same assisted investigation; not independent scientific replication.
scope: Historical supervisor review and new admission/monitoring failure semantics. No model/image/empirical predictions inspected or executed; no scientific endpoint or performance assessment.

qualification.scope: Strict numeric/duplicate/nonfinite schema, misleading reserved-capacity observation, missing/slow/malformed sampling, output/symlink/collision protection, journal/log/receipt write errors, worker poll/exit races, explicit unknown RSS, missing terminal, pending fsync failure and no-overwrite final publication. Actual tiny fixture workers are network denied; injected providers are marked authored_injected. No models or empirical data.
qualification.intermediate_receipt_fsync_finding: The earlier guard could leave a complete-looking final receipt on fsync failure while CLI returned1. Final guard writes an exclusive pending receipt first and does not publish final on that failure. Prior authored evidence remains retained.

accepted_semantics: Prelaunch samples and immediately-before-launch sample require measured available bytes above preserved floor plus full declared logical output budget, stated allocation rounding allowance and margin. Missing/slow/invalid observations fail closed.

Running samples preserve the exact trigger and require floor plus margin plus remaining declared allocation estimate. Logical output, billed st_blocks allocation and available filesystem bytes remain distinct.
A stop reason cannot become complete because of an exit-zero polling race. Missing terminal, changed input or failed post-observation prevents complete.
Budget reserves two transient 64KiB receipt names and next 8KiB journal row. Receipt publication uses exclusive pending write/fsync and no-overwrite hard link; failure remains non-success.
No raw retention, processing threshold, model/image selection or scientific matching semantics changed by this guard.
required_consumer_contract: Require observed outer supervisor returncode0; never accept a final receipt by itself. A cleanup failure after linking can leave a final file while CLI correctly returns1.

Require status complete, receipt_persisted true, termination_reason null, child returncode0, exact prospective source/capacity/runtime/worker bindings, and matching saved sample-journal/result digests.

Pending receipts and missing or inconsistent external receipts remain unaccepted. New receipt schema needs an explicitly qualified downstream adapter; historical complete-pair checker acceptance is not inherited.
limits: The preflight sequence is an observed window, not a forecast or exclusive APFS reservation. Competing writes can cross a boundary between samples.
st_blocks sums and fragment-rounding allowance do not identify unique clone extents, volume metadata, purgeable reclamation or a guaranteed physical worst case; margin is explicit but not a proof.

Resource bounds are sampled except declared child kernel limits; process-tree containment, continuous RSS/floor enforcement, local-administrator race resistance and crash/directory-fsync durability are not established.
No real-system capacity admission probe was performed by this review role. Passing authored controls does not authorize model inference or establish current sufficient storage.
next_dependencies: Parent may freeze a harmless exact-input-free system-provider admission probe, preserving refusal if capacity is inadequate.

Any later same-input detector attempt requires a separate prospective plan, observed sufficient headroom, unchanged scientific inputs and exact600s/3GiB numerical limits, and a qualified consumer for this supervisor receipt.
The incomplete four-image comparison remains incomplete; no use of partial prior predictions or altered cohort is supported.
